$Comment: One rung of the Night Owl ladder, counting Kweebec Nightmare rounds won on any preset.
Target 'kweebec:' with MatchMode PREFIX matches every mode that mod runs, so a co-op clear and
a PvP win both count and a mode added later counts the day it ships. Leaving Qualifier out is
what keeps every difficulty preset eligible; write one to pin a rung to a single preset.
The hytale:mod_installed factor reads 1 while the Kweebec Nightmare mod is loaded and 0 while it
is not, so the Min 1 bound is what keeps the ladder out of sight on a server without it. Keep the
bound - a condition with no bound at all is satisfied by the 0 too.
Listing.Chains is what makes the three rungs read as one climb on the page rather than as three
near-identical entries. All three share ONE description line and differ only in how many wins
they ask for: Text.TextArgs.Flavor fills the number from the criterion's own Amount, so a
balance pass changes one number here and no translation at all.
The armour piece is a ClaimReward, so it waits in the achievements menu to be collected instead
of arriving mid-round with a full bag.
